text: うみでも　かわでも！

structure.jp: うみでも　かわでも！
structure.en: whether in the sea or in a river!

patterns.name: 〜でも〜でも
patterns.span: うみでも　かわでも
patterns.explanation: でも said twice after two places means 'whether in this one or in that one', it makes no difference. うみでもかわでも = 'in the sea or in a river, either one'.
